omar: Heads-up from nightly canary: small cohort hit p95 spikes during drain with sticky leases. Seems like KV cold reads on target.
omar: impact ~3-5% requests 1.6x p95 for ~12m.
rachel: was affinity enforced?
omar: yes, session affinity kept routing to old hosts, but some new requests were sent to targets before their KV warmed and they went to disk.
tony: To avoid rollback I sketched a 'transactional-handoff' idea: treat handoff as a 3-step protocol: 1) prefetch phase (async prewarm), 2) probe phase (tiny fraction of real requests routed), 3) commit (ramp weights). Each step has local health checks.
rachel: How is this different than earlier probe-only approaches?
tony: prefetch-phase is passive: we keep traffic on source but send prefetch signals for likely prefixes to the target. Probe phase actually routes small percentage. This reduces user-impact while giving target warm state.
omar: sounds solid. need compact decision metrics. proposing: p95_ratio, prefetch_hit_rate, probe_error_rate, and target_queue_smoothed. Keep decision logic in routing plane per-cohort with central override.
maggie: config sketch (store strings in proto):
```json
{"strategy":"transactional-handoff","prefetch_start":"1","prefetch_max":"10","probe_start":"1","probe_max":"8","probe_window_s":"45","p95_ratio_thresh":"1.5","prefetch_hit_thresh":"0.7","probe_success_thresh":"0.85"}
```
omar: Add hysteresis: require N consecutive windows meeting criteria before moving to next phase, and exponential backoff on failures.
rachel: session handling? keep sticky for in-flight sessions, but prefetch for new session messages. For mid-session migration we can implement a 'lease-transfer' path (explicit prefix copy) as an opt-in.
tony: agree. lease-transfer requires a transactional copy of KV subset; heavier but good for VIP tenants. We'll include API for 'migrate_prefixes' that owners can enable.
maggie: observability: Console needs per-cohort state (phase), prefetch_rate, probe_rate, prefetch_hit, probe_success, p95_ratio, and sampled traces. Also add a 'handoff-score' gauge (0-100) derived from signals to make human ops quicker.
omar: runbook: on handoff-fail alert run quick checks: recent drains, prefetch_hit trend, probe_errors, and target queue. Actions: 1) pause commit, 2) increase prefetch_ratio, 3) enable temporary sticky-extension, or 4) rollback.
rachel: testing: unit state transitions, sim with variable prefix reuse vs prefetch cost, canary with synthetic long-chat workload, chaos injecting target KV delays.
tony: I'll build a simulator to sweep thresholds and compute expected extra prefetch ops vs probability of fallback.
canary-bot: scheduled-canary: job 2024-06-15T02:00Z created for variant v9; will emit handoff events to eng-infra channel.
maggie: add alerts: handoff_score < 30 for >3m, probe_fail_rate > 0.2 over 5m.
omar: minor UX ask: Console should let SREs trigger an immediate 'prefetch-only' boost for a cohort from UI.
rachel: also request tenant-tagging so high-reuse tenants get prioritized prefetch lanes.
tony: will include tenant-priority in sim.
maggie: I'll draft dashboards and wire alerts.
tony: i'll open RFC with config proto, state machine, and runbook. will attach sim results.
omar: thanks team. I'll coordinate the first canary with eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
